book.name: Uraat To Yes Mbaŋooŋa
book.title: Uraat To Yes Mbaŋooŋa To Yesu Krisi Wok Bilong Ol Aposel—The Acts Of The Apostles

content: Tipayoon Petrus yesuru Yoan pa savsaveeŋ
Petrus yesuru Yoan tisavsaav pa tamtoghon sone, ve ndiran pida to watooŋrau, ve daba to yes uraata to tiŋgin Rumai Tiina, toman Sadusi pida tiŋarua di tinim.
Yes tinim toman atedi yabyab pasa, yesuru tipatoot tamtoghon pa Maaron aliŋa, ve tivovotia saveeŋ padi tighaze yes to tinim Yesu le ve tineep tuŋia ila toni, Maaron pale ipamundigin di pa mateeŋ.
Sawa tonenen, rabrab izi wa. Tovenen tikis yesuru, ve tighur di tilooŋ tila ruum to yabyabuuŋ. Leso tineep tonowe ve ndugizau, ghoro titiir saveeŋ todi.
Yes to tilooŋ saveeŋ to yesuru, katindi titoor ŋgar todi ve tighur ila to Yesu. Tovenen tiŋgal yes to muŋginadi ne, le tinim ival kat. Nditamoot todi moghon irau ndiŋndiŋ liim (5000) ma venen.
Mboŋ ndugizau, ghoro pooza to yes Yuda, toman ŋginiiŋa todi ve ndiran ŋgara pida to tutuuŋ tilup di izi Yerusalem.
Ve Anas to daba muŋgina to watooŋrau, toman Kaiapas to igham Anas ina, Yoan, Aleksander, ve Anas siŋ toni pida, yes tisob tineep ila lupuuŋ tonowen paam.

Tilup di ve tinepneep, ve tigham Petrus yesuru Yoan tinim, ve tipayoon di ila matadi, ve tighason di tighaze: “Ai, mbeb to noor ivot, yamru agham tapirimim vena, to agham mbeb tonenen ivot? Ve agham uraat tonenen ila sei iza?”
Avuvu Patabuaŋ izeev Petrus, ve ye isaav padi ighaze: “Yam pooza ve yam ŋginiiŋa, vena?
Aazne, aghaze aghason ghei pa uraat poia to ivot pa ŋgeu narape tonene, ve ataam to ye tini poia pani, tauto agham ghei ninim ne?

Poia. You naghaze yamŋa Israela asob awatag kat tovene: Yesu Krisi to Nasaret to yam arabi izala ai pambarooŋ ve imaat, ve Maaron ipamundigini pa mateeŋ, ila ye iza ve tapiri, ŋgeu to aazne iyondyood ila matamim ne tini poia. Mbaŋ 3:13+
Yesu tonene to muuŋ timbood saveeŋ iza toni tighaze:

content.text: ‘Yaam to yam ndiran to reiŋ ruum matamim velegini ve apiyaava ilale, tauto inim pughu pa ruum ve ipaloti. Leso ruum iyoon ariaŋa izala pogho.’

content: “Yesu moghon to Maaron ighuri inim Volaaŋa pait. Tamtoghon ite paam to taan le iza pa uraat tovene maau. Ila ye iza moghon, tauto Maaron igham mulin ghiit pa pataŋani to sosor toit, ve taneep pooi.” Mt 1:21; Mbaŋ 10:43; Ro 10:13

Yes daba tonowen tiwatag: Petrus ve Yoan, yesuru tamtoghon to paanu moghon. Tila skul tiina eta maau. Eemoghon tighita yesuru timatughez maau, ve tiyoon ariaŋa kat pa savsaveeŋ. Tovenen tigham ŋgar naol padi, ve tighilaal di tighaze muuŋ, yesŋa Yesu tilaghlaagh.
Ve tighita narape to yesuru tighami aghe poia ne, yesŋa tiyondyood. Tovenen irau tisavia saveeŋ eta maau.
Tauto tizurun Petrus yesuru Yoan pa lupuuŋ todi ve tivot tila pumuri, ve yes moghon tiwasavon di.

Tighaze: “Laak, pale tagham vena pa yesuru? Pasa, mbeb gharatooŋa tiina to tighami, nene ipatooŋ Maaron tapiri ivot ighazooŋ, ve ival tiina to tineep Yerusalem ne, tisob tiwatagi wa. Tovenen ighaze tatoova pa tatatan saveeŋ to yesuru taghaze kaarom, nene irau tamtoghon tilooŋ ghiit maau. Yo 11:47
Eemoghon iit irau tarab matin saveeŋ tonene. Pa vene, varu ilaan ila ve tamtoghon tisob tiwatagi. Tovenen taŋgalsekin di ariaŋa. Leso tivotia saveeŋ pa tamtoghon ila ŋgeu tonowen iza muul sob.”
Tiwasavon di le isob, ghoro tipoi mbaŋooŋa ru tonenen tilooŋ tinim muul, ve tisaav ariaŋa padi tighaze tisavia saveeŋ eta pa tamtoghon ila Yesu iza malep, ve tipatoot di pani muul malep. Mbaŋ 5:28,40
Eemoghon yesuru tipamuul aliŋadi tighaze: “Yam taumim aŋgabiiz: Ŋgar sine to deŋia ila Maaron mata? Pale nilooŋ yam aliŋamim ve nitaghoni, ma nitaghon Maaron aliŋa? Mbaŋ 5:29
Pasa, mbeb tiina to yeru nighita ve nilooŋa, nene irau neneeŋamai pani maau. Pale nisasavia moghon tovene.”

Yesuru tisaav tovene, ve yes daba tonenen tigham saveeŋ matughezaaŋ padi muul. Ghoro tipul di tila. Yes tighaze tiŋgal yesuru matadi. Eemoghon tiraua maau. Pasa, narape to mbeb gharatooŋa tonowen ivot pani, ndaman toni ilib pa tamoot ru (40) wa. Tovenen mbeb to ivot, nene igham ival tiina tisob tipapait Maaron iza pa tapiri ve poia toni.
Yes to tighur ila to Yesu, tighason Maaron pa ipalot di, leso tiyoon ariaŋa
Yes daba tonenen tipul Petrus yesuru Yoan tila, ve malmalidi tila to nditadi, ve tipaesia saveeŋ to yes daba to watooŋrau ve yes ŋginiiŋa tisavia padi.
Nditadi tilooŋ paesiiŋ todi, ve tisob tilup lolodi inim ee moghon, ve titaŋ roran Maaron tighaze: “Tiina tiei, yom ughur sambam, taan, ve te, toman mbeb tisob to tineep ila, ve uŋgin di.
Muuŋ, Avuvum Patabuaŋ ipamundigin timbumai David to mbesooŋa tiom, ve isaav tovene:

content.text: ‘Pughu vena to ndug ndug atedi yabyab ve tighaze tipamundigin malmal?
Tamtoghon tikaal ataam pa tigham didiaaŋ pasa? Ŋgar todi irau ighur maau. Tighami sorok.
Yes kinik to taan tigham aghedi tighaze tigham malmal.
Yes pooza tilup di, ve tikaal ataam pa tizoor Maaron ve titatan Mesia toni.’ Mbo 2:1+

content: “Saveeŋ tonene, aazne anoŋa ivot wa. Pasa, yom taum ughur Yesu, to mbesooŋa tiom patabuaŋ, inim Mesia. Eemoghon Erod yesuru Piladus toman yes to Yuda maau ne, ve ival tiina to Israel paam, tilup di izi ndug tiina tonene, ve tikaal ataam pa tizoor saveeŋ toni ve titatani. Tauto tirabi imaat. Lu 23:7+
Eemoghon ŋgar to tigham pani, nene itaghon taum ŋgar tiom. Matam iŋgal muuŋ wa ughaze ila taum tapirim, yom pale ugham mbeb tonene ivot. Mbaŋ 2:23

O Maaron, saveeŋ matughezaaŋ to tighamgham payei ne, yom uwatagi wa. Tovenen yei to ninim mbesooŋa tiom ne, nitaŋ roran ghom nighaze upalot ghei. Leso nimatughez sob, ve niyoon ariaŋa pa votiaaŋ saveeŋ tiom. Mbaŋ 13:46; Ep 6:19+; Pil 1:14

Upatooŋ tapirim ivot ighazooŋ, ve ugharaat yes moroghooŋa le tinidi popoia, ve ugham mbeb gharatooŋadi tintina tivot ila mbesooŋa tiom patabuaŋ Yesu iza, leso tinim ghilalooŋ pa tamtoghon, ve tighur ila toni.”

Tisuŋ le isob, ghoro Maaron tapiri itok ndug to tilup di pani, le irur inimale yoŋgyoog itok. Ve Avuvu Patabuaŋ izeev di tisob. Tauto timatughez maau, ve tiyoon ariaŋa pa votiaaŋ Maaron aliŋa pa tamtoghon. Mbaŋ 2:2+
Yes to tighur ila to Yesu tiwaulan di

Yes to tighur ila to Yesu, tisob lolodi ve ŋgar todi ee moghon, ve tiwaulan di. Todi eta iŋguruut mbeb toni ve isaav ighaze nene mbeb to tau moghon ne maau. Tighita mbeb todi tisob tighaze nene mbeb to ival tisob. Lu 12:33; Mbaŋ 2:44+
Ve yes mbaŋooŋa tipariaaŋ saveeŋ pa mundigiiŋ to Tiina toit Yesu, leso tamtoghon tighur ila toni. Ve uraat todi ilandaad toman tapiri. Tauto Maaron poia toni tiina inepneep toman di tisob.

Tamtoghon todi eta imbool pa mbeb eta maau. Pasa, yes to ledi taan ma ruum, tigholgholia mbeb todi, ve tighamgham yaama ve tighurghuri ila to yes mbaŋooŋa. Ghoro anadi tireii pa yes to mbolaaŋ igham di. 2Kor 8:13+

Tauto ŋgeu eez to mutu Saiprus, iza Yosep, ye paam igholia taan toni, ve igham yaama ve ighuri ila to yes mbaŋooŋa. Yosep tonene, pughu toni ivot ila to Levi. Ve yes mbaŋooŋa titoor iza, ve tiwaata tighaze Banabas. (Pisis Banabas, pughu tovene: ‘Ŋgeu to ipapalot tamtoghon.’) Mbaŋ 9:27, 11:22,30, 13:2

footnotes.text: Yes Sadusi tighur ila tighaze mateeŋa irau timundig muul maau (Mt 22:23). Tauto atedi yabyab pa saveeŋ to Petrus yesuru Yoan.

Anas inim daba to watooŋrau, ve muri ghoro, rawa Kaiapas igham ina. Tovenen sawa to tirab Yesu imaat, ve inim sawa to tipayoon Petrus yesuru Yoan pa savsaveeŋ, Kaipas ye daba to watooŋrau. Eemoghon Anas iza ‘daba to watooŋrau’ inepneep sone.
Ruum to saveeŋ waaro tonene isavia, nene tamtoghon to Maaron lupuuŋ todi. Ve yaam to inim pughu pa ruum, nene Yesu tau.
